notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 2 life this turn.
description:

When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Cast Junk Diver by paying {0}.
When Junk Diver enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Junk Diver.
When Junk Diver dies, it triggers, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {0}.
